```{r make_designDF}
rawcounts <- t(rawcounts)
colnames(rawcounts) <- str_extract(colnames(rawcounts), "lib[0-9]+")
```

# RNAseq Quality Control

```{r assess_sample_quality}

# Set QC cut-offs
alignCut = 70
totalReadsCut = 1
medianCVCut = 0.9

# Determine which libraries pass QC based on assigned thresholds
design$qcPass <- design$fastq_total_reads > totalReadsCut*10^6 &
  design$pct_aligned > alignCut &
  design$median_cv_coverage < medianCVCut

```

```{r make_qc_cuts}

# Make new design DF containing libraries that pass QC
designQC <- design %>%
  dplyr::filter(qcPass == TRUE)
dim(designQC) 

# Subset rawcounts from libids that passed QC
rawcountsQC <- rawcounts[,colnames(rawcounts) %in% designQC$libid]
dim(rawcountsQC) 

# Ensure that libraries in rawcountsQC and designQC are in the same order
libOrder <- match(colnames(rawcountsQC), designQC$libid)
libOrder # vector of positions that match 
designQC <- designQC[libOrder,] 

```

# Gene filtering and normalization of protein-coding gene counts

```{r protein_coding_genes}

# Keep protein coding genes with MGNC symbols; drop non-protein-coding genes
# v38 <- annotables::grcm38 # Name changed from grcm38 to grcm39 on new version 8/21/2026
v38 <- annotables::grcm39
pc38 <- v38[v38$biotype == "protein_coding",] # get protein coding genes from v38
pcNoSymbol <- pc38[pc38$symbol == "",] 
pcWithSymbol <- pc38[pc38$symbol != "",]

# Subset genes from rawcountsQC with MGNC symbol
rawcountsWithSymbol <- rawcountsQC[rownames(rawcountsQC) %in% pcWithSymbol$ensgene,]
dim(rawcountsWithSymbol) 

rawcountsWithSymbol <- as.data.frame(rawcountsWithSymbol)

# Add gene symbol column
rawcountsWithSymbol$gene <- pcWithSymbol$symbol[match(rownames(rawcountsWithSymbol),
                                                            pcWithSymbol$ensgene)]

# Aggregate/sum counts for duplicated MGNC symbols. 
pcRawcounts <- rawcountsWithSymbol %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(across(starts_with("lib"), sum)) %>% 
  arrange(gene) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble:: column_to_rownames("gene") # move gene symbols to rownames
dim(pcRawcounts) 

```

```{r gene_filtering}

# Helper function to filter lowly expressed genes
gene_filter_func <- function(counts_in,  
                             minlib_pct = 0.1, # min. percent of total libs
                             minCPM = 1){ # set minimum CPM
  
  # Normalize counts to CPM 
  normCPM <- as.data.frame(t(t(counts_in*10^6)/colSums(counts_in)))

  # Keep gene if normCPM is >= to the minCPM & >= minlib_pct
  keepGenes <- rowSums(normCPM >= minCPM) >= minlib_pct*ncol(normCPM)
  filteredGenes <- counts_in[keepGenes, ]
  filteredGenes <- drop_na(filteredGenes)
  
  return(filteredGenes)
 
}

# Filter out genes with low expression
pcCountsFiltered <- gene_filter_func(pcRawcounts, 0.1, 1)
dim(pcCountsFiltered)

```

```{r norm_filtered_rawcounts}

# Helper function to normalize filtered counts using tmm for bulk RNAseq datasets 
normalize_counts_func <- function(counts_in, method){
   
     if(method == "decon"){
       # Normalize using the deconvolution algorithm
       decon_norm_factors = scran::computeSumFactors(as.matrix(counts_in))
       counts_norm = as.data.frame(t(t(counts_in)/decon_norm_factors))
       }
    if(method == "tmm"){
      dge <- DGEList(counts_in)
      dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
      counts_norm <- cpm(dge, normalized.lib.sizes=TRUE)
      }
  
  return(counts_norm)
}

# Normalize counts
pcCountsNorm <- as.data.frame(normalize_counts_func(pcCountsFiltered, "tmm"))

```

## PCA, No IRF5ko data

```{r remove_libs_IRF5ko_containing_chimeras}

# Remove libraries that are from chimeras containing IRF5ko cells and 
# non-Ly6Chi mono from WT:WT chimeras
noKOdesign <- designQC %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("IRF5ko", chimera)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(grepl("WT", chimera) & celltype %in% c("IntMono", "PatMono", "iHPC")))

noKOdesign <- droplevels(noKOdesign)

# Check
unique(noKOdesign$chimera) 
unique(noKOdesign$genotype)
dim(noKOdesign)

table(noKOdesign$chimera, noKOdesign$celltype)

# Subset pcCountsNorm from libids in noKOdesign
noKOcounts <- pcCountsNorm[,colnames(pcCountsNorm) %in% noKOdesign$libid]
dim(noKOcounts)

# Ensure that libs are in same order
libOrder <- match(colnames(noKOcounts), noKOdesign$libid)
libOrder # vector of positions that match 

```

```{r run_pca_no_libs_from_IRF5koContaining_chimeras}

# Run PCA on the normalized log2 transformed counts
noKOpca <- prcomp(log2(as.data.frame(t(noKOcounts))+1), center=TRUE, scale=FALSE)

# Get summary info of component importance, pca scores
noKOpcaSum <- summary(noKOpca)

noKOpcaVar <- as.data.frame(t(noKOpcaSum$importance))
noKOpcaVar$pc <- factor(row.names(noKOpcaVar), levels = mixedsort(row.names(noKOpcaVar)))

noKOpcaScores <- as.data.frame(noKOpca$x)
noKOpcaScores$libid <- row.names(noKOpcaScores)

# Merge pca scores with design
noKOpcaScores <- merge(noKOdesign, noKOpcaScores, 
                       by.x = "libid", by.y = "row.names")

```

# Functions for DGE analysis

```{r functions_for_differential_analysis}

categorize <- function(object, regulationCategories, logFC_cutoff = 1, p_cutoff = 0.05) {
  object$change <- regulationCategories[3]
  object$change[object$logFC >= +logFC_cutoff & object$adj.P.Val < p_cutoff] <- regulationCategories[1]
  object$change[object$logFC <= -logFC_cutoff& object$adj.P.Val < p_cutoff] <- regulationCategories[2]
  object$change <- factor(object$change, levels = regulationCategories)
  
  return(object)
}

```

```{r initialize_empty_dgeAnalysis_variables}

# Initialize empty lists for DGE analysis
designMat <- list()
vwts <- list()
contrasts <- list()
contrastCoefs <- list()
vfit <- list()
corfit <- list()
vfitEB <- list()
topTables <- list()

```

# DGE analysis

## Model: spleen_celltype_genotype from TLR7.1:TLR7.1_IRF5ko chimeras

```{r define_model_spleen_celltype_genotype}

#DGE cutoffs
logfc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

modelName <- "spleen_celltype_genotype_TTkoChimeras"
folderName <- modelName

dir.create(file.path(dirTables, folderName), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(dirPlots, folderName), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Designate chimera type for exported file names
chimeraType <- "TTkoChimeras"

#Subset designQC to include only iHPCs and Ly6ChiMono from spleen of TLR7.1:TLR7.1_IRF5ko chimeras
designModel <- designQC %>%
    dplyr::filter(chimera == "TLR7.1_IRF5ko_CD45.2:TLR7.1_CD45.1.2") %>%
    dplyr::filter(celltype == "Ly6ChiMono" | celltype == "iHPC")

designModel <- droplevels(designModel)

# Make a copy for combined export later 
designTTkoChimeras <- designModel
    
designModel$celltype_genotype <- paste0(designModel$celltype, "_", designModel$genotype)
unique(designModel$celltype_genotype)

modelCounts <- pcCountsNorm[ , designModel$libid]

table(designModel$celltype_genotype)
table(designModel$celltype, designModel$genotype)
table(designModel$celltype_genotype, designModel$project)

designMat[[modelName]] <- model.matrix(~ 0 + celltype_genotype, data = designModel)

# Clean up column names
print(colnames(designMat[[modelName]]))

colnames(designMat[[modelName]]) <- colnames(designMat[[modelName]]) %>%
  str_remove_all("celltype_genotype") 
print(colnames(designMat[[modelName]]))

```

```{r run_de_analysis}

# Run the differential expression analysis; include donor mouse (mouseID) as random effect
# 1. Calculate the voom weights
vwts[[modelName]]  <- voomWithQualityWeights(modelCounts, 
                                             design = designMat[[modelName]], 
                                             plot = T, span = 0.1)

# 1.a. include mouse as random effect in limma
# https://support.bioconductor.org/p/59700/
corfit[[modelName]] <-  duplicateCorrelation(vwts[[modelName]],
                        design = designMat[[modelName]],
                        block = designModel$mouseID)
corfit[[modelName]]$consensus.correlation

# 1.b rerun voom
vwts[[modelName]] <- voomWithQualityWeights(modelCounts,
                                            design= designMat[[modelName]],
                                            block = designModel$mouseID,
                                            correlation = corfit[[modelName]]$consensus,
                                            plot = T)

#2. linear fit with donor effect
vfit[[modelName]] <- lmFit(vwts[[modelName]], design = designMat[[modelName]],
                           block = designModel$mouseID,
                           correlation = corfit[[modelName]]$consensus)

# 3. Calculate contrast coefficients
contrasts[[modelName]] = makeContrasts(
                      Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1_IRF5ko - Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1,
                      # IntMono_TLR7.1_IRF5ko - IntMono_TLR7.1,
                      # PatMono_TLR7.1_IRF5ko - PatMono_TLR7.1,
                      iHPC_TLR7.1 - Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1,
                      
                      levels = designMat[[modelName]])

contrastCoefs[[modelName]] <- contrasts.fit(vfit[[modelName]], contrasts[[modelName]])

# 4. Correct for multiple testing (FDR) using empirical Bayes function
vfitEB[[modelName]] <- eBayes(contrastCoefs[[modelName]])

```

```{r parse_contrasts}

contrastSummary <- data.frame(name = colnames(contrasts[[modelName]]))

contrastSummary$studyGroup <- sapply(strsplit(contrastSummary$name, " -"), function(x) x[1])
unique(contrastSummary$studyGroup)
contrastSummary$refGroup <- sapply(strsplit(contrastSummary$name, "- "), function(x) x[2])
unique(contrastSummary$refGroup)

print(contrastSummary)

```

```{r write_out_top_genes}

for (iContrast in 1:ncol(contrastCoefs[[modelName]])) {
  contrastName <- colnames(contrastCoefs[[modelName]])[iContrast]

  top.table <- topTable(vfitEB[[modelName]], coef = iContrast, sort.by = "P", n = Inf)
  setDT(top.table, keep.rownames = "gene")
  
  top.table <- categorize(top.table, enrichmentCategories, logFC_cutoff = logfc_cutoff, p_cutoff = p_cutoff)
  
  top.table_ <- dplyr::select(top.table, -"t", -"B")
  
  #change to three significant digits
  top.table_$AveExpr <- signif(top.table_$AveExpr, digits = 3)
  top.table_$P.Value <- signif(top.table_$P.Value, digits = 3)
  top.table_$adj.P.Val <- signif(top.table_$adj.P.Val, digits = 3)
  top.table_$logFC <- signif(top.table_$logFC, digits = 3)

  #change column names
  top.table_ <- top.table_ %>%
      dplyr::rename(log2FC = logFC,
                    p.Value = P.Value)
  
  out_file <- paste0("DEgenes_", contrastName, "_", chimeraType, ".csv")
  out_file_path <- file.path(dirTables, folderName, out_file)
  
  write.csv(top.table_,
            out_file_path,
            row.names = F,
            quote=F)
  
  top.table$contrast <- contrastName
  
  topTables[[modelName]][[contrastName]] = top.table
}

```

### Volcano plots

```{r volcano_plot}

for (iContrast in 1:nrow(contrastSummary) ) {
  contrastName <-  contrastSummary$name[iContrast]
  contrastPrintName <- contrastSummary$printName[iContrast]
  
  top.table <- topTables[[modelName]][[iContrast]]
  sig.genes <- top.table$adj.P.Val < p_cutoff
  
  print(paste0("Contrast: ", contrastPrintName))
  print("Breakdown of significant genes:")
  print(table(sig.genes))
  
  study_group <- contrastSummary$studyGroup[iContrast]
  ref_group <- contrastSummary$refGroup[iContrast]
  
  xlim <- max(abs(top.table$logFC))
  
  vp <- top.table %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(adj.P.Val)) %>% # sort so that the color points get plotted on top of greys
      ggplot(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = change)) + 
      geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2.5, shape = 19) +
      scale_color_manual(values = enrichmentColors,
                         name = "", font) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), color="black", linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = -logfc_cutoff, color="black", linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = +logfc_cutoff, color="black", linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.3) +
      theme_bw() + 
      theme(legend.position="right",
            aspect.ratio = 1) + 
      labs(y = "-log10 FDR", x = "log2 FC", 
           title = paste0("Change in ", study_group, " compared to ", ref_group)) +
      xlim(-xlim, xlim) 

  print(vp)
  
  vp_exportPlotName <- paste0("vp_", contrastName, "_", chimeraType, ".pdf")

  ggsave(filename = file.path(dirPlots, folderName, vp_exportPlotName),
         plot = vp, width = 8, height = 8)
}

```

## Model: splenic_iHPC_signature from TLR7.1:TLR7.1 chimeras

```{r define_model_splenic_iHPCsignature}

# Get genes that are differentially expressed in splenic iHPC vs splenic Ly6Chi mono (TLR7.1:TLR7.1 chimeras) and separate into genes that are up in iHPCs relative to ly6chi mono and genes that are down in iHPCs relative to ly6chi mono. 

# DGE cutoffs
logfc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

modelName <- "iHPC_signature_spleen_TTchimeras"
folderName <- modelName

dir.create(file.path(dirTables, folderName), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(dirPlots, folderName), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Designate chimera type for exported file names
chimeraType <- "TTchimeras"

#Subset designQC to include only iHPCs and Ly6ChiMono from spleen of TLR7.1:TLR7.1 chimeras 
designModel <- designQC %>%
  dplyr::filter(chimera == "TLR7.1_CD45.2:TLR7.1_CD45.1.2") %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype == "Ly6ChiMono" | celltype == "iHPC")

designModel <- droplevels(designModel)

# Make copy for combined export later
designTTchimeras <- designModel
    
designModel$celltype_genotype <- paste0(designModel$celltype, "_", designModel$genotype)
unique(designModel$celltype_genotype)

modelCounts <- pcCountsNorm[ , designModel$libid]

table(designModel$celltype_genotype)
table(designModel$celltype, designModel$genotype)
table(designModel$celltype_genotype, designModel$project)

designMat[[modelName]] <- model.matrix(~ 0 + celltype_genotype, data = designModel)

print(colnames(designMat[[modelName]]))

colnames(designMat[[modelName]]) <- colnames(designMat[[modelName]]) %>%
  str_remove_all("celltype_genotype") 
print(colnames(designMat[[modelName]]))

```

```{r run_de_analysis_splenic_iHPCsignature}

# Run the differential expression analysis; include donor mouse (mouseID) as random effect
# 1. Calculate the voom weights
vwts[[modelName]]  <- voomWithQualityWeights(modelCounts, 
                                             design = designMat[[modelName]], 
                                             plot = T, span = 0.1)

# 1.a. include mouse as random effect in limma
# https://support.bioconductor.org/p/59700/
corfit[[modelName]] <-  duplicateCorrelation(vwts[[modelName]],
                        design = designMat[[modelName]],
                        block = designModel$mouseID)
corfit[[modelName]]$consensus.correlation 

# 1.b rerun voom
vwts[[modelName]] <- voomWithQualityWeights(modelCounts,
                                            design= designMat[[modelName]],
                                            block = designModel$mouseID,
                                            correlation = corfit[[modelName]]$consensus,
                                            plot = T)

#2. linear fit with donor effect
vfit[[modelName]] <- lmFit(vwts[[modelName]], design = designMat[[modelName]],
                           block = designModel$mouseID,
                           correlation = corfit[[modelName]]$consensus)

# 3. Calculate contrast coefficients
contrasts[[modelName]] = makeContrasts(iHPC_TLR7.1 - Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1,
                                       levels = designMat[[modelName]]) 

contrastCoefs[[modelName]] <- contrasts.fit(vfit[[modelName]], contrasts[[modelName]])

# 4. Correct for multiple testing (FDR) using empirical Bayes function
vfitEB[[modelName]] <- eBayes(contrastCoefs[[modelName]])

```

```{r parse_contrasts_splenic_iHPCsignature}

contrastSummary <- data.frame(name = colnames(contrasts[[modelName]]))

contrastSummary$studyGroup <- sapply(strsplit(contrastSummary$name, " -"), function(x) x[1])
unique(contrastSummary$studyGroup)
contrastSummary$refGroup <- sapply(strsplit(contrastSummary$name, "- "), function(x) x[2])
unique(contrastSummary$refGroup)

# Format print name
contrastSummary$printName <- contrastSummary$name
contrastSummary$printName <- str_replace_all(contrastSummary$printName, "-", "vs.")
unique(contrastSummary$printName)

print(contrastSummary)

```

```{r write_out_top_genes_splenic_iHPCsignature}

for (iContrast in 1:ncol(contrastCoefs[[modelName]])) {
  contrastName <- colnames(contrastCoefs[[modelName]])[iContrast]

  top.table <- topTable(vfitEB[[modelName]], coef = iContrast, sort.by = "P", n = Inf)
  setDT(top.table, keep.rownames = "gene")
  
  top.table <- categorize(top.table, enrichmentCategories, logFC_cutoff = logfc_cutoff, p_cutoff = p_cutoff)
  
  top.table_ <- dplyr::select(top.table, -"t", -"B")
  
  #change to three significant digits
  top.table_$AveExpr <- signif(top.table_$AveExpr, digits = 3)
  top.table_$P.Value <- signif(top.table_$P.Value, digits = 3)
  top.table_$adj.P.Val <- signif(top.table_$adj.P.Val, digits = 3)
  top.table_$logFC <- signif(top.table_$logFC, digits = 3)

  #change column names
  top.table_ <- top.table_ %>%
      dplyr::rename(log2FC = logFC,
                    p.Value = P.Value)
  
  out_file <- paste0("spleen_DEgenes_", contrastName, "_", chimeraType, ".csv")
  out_file_path <- file.path(dirTables, folderName, out_file)
  
  write.csv(top.table_,
            out_file_path,
            row.names = F,
            quote=F)
  
  top.table$contrast <- contrastName
  
  topTables[[modelName]][[contrastName]] = top.table
}

```

# Heatmap: overlapping Corbin CD11c+ Mac genes and up in iHPCs transcripts/accessible chromatin

Chimeras and celltype/genotypes to include:
From TLR7:TLR7 chimeras - TLR7.1 Ly6ChiMono, TLR7.1 iHPCs
From WT:WT chimeras - WT Ly6Chi Mono

```{r read_in_files_get_geneLists}

# Read in gene list of upregulated CD11c+ Mac genes from Corbin et al.
cd11cMacUpDF <- read.csv(file.path(dirProject, "info", "forManuscript", 
                                 "upregGenes_CD11cMac_CorbinEtAl.csv"))
cd11cMacUp <- cd11cMacUpDF$upregGenes_cd11cMac_Corbin

# Read in list of genes of more accessible chromatin in iHPCs from parallel 
# ATACseq exp (analyzed by LeAnn)
accGenesDF <- read.csv(file.path(dirProject, "info", "forManuscript", 
                                 "genes_moreAccessibleChrom_iHPCs.csv"))
accGenes <- accGenesDF$moreAccGenes_iHPCs

# Read in DE genes table of Ly6Chi mono vs. iHPC (TLR7.1) for RNAseq, i.e. transcripts
iHPCupTransDF <- read.csv(file.path(dirTables, "iHPC_signature_spleen_TTchimeras",
                              "spleen_DEgenes_iHPC_TLR7.1 - Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1_TTchimeras_changedCategNames.csv"))
upTransc <- iHPCupTransDF %>%
  dplyr::filter(change == "up in iHPCs") %>%
  pull(gene)

overlapGenes <- Reduce(intersect, list(cd11cMacUp, accGenes, upTransc))
print(overlapGenes)

```

```{r make_heatmap_overlappingGeneSets}

folderName <- "iHPC_signature_spleen_TTchimeras"

# Make heatmap   
# Subset design to celltypes/genotypes of interest
hmDesign <- designQC %>%
  dplyr::filter(chimera == "TLR7.1_CD45.2:TLR7.1_CD45.1.2" & celltype %in% c("Ly6ChiMono", "iHPC") |
                  chimera == "WT_CD45.2:WT_CD45.1.2" & celltype == "Ly6ChiMono")

hmDesign <- droplevels(hmDesign)

# Put samples in order for heatmap   
hmOrder <- order(hmDesign$celltype, hmDesign$genotype, 
                 hmDesign$mouseID, hmDesign$libid)
hmDesign <- hmDesign[hmOrder, ]
    
# Subset pcCountsNorm to relevant samples and genes
hmPcCountsNorm <- pcCountsNorm[ , hmDesign$libid]
hmCounts <- hmPcCountsNorm[rownames(hmPcCountsNorm) %in% overlapGenes, ]
  
tp <- t(scale(t(log2(1+hmCounts))))

# Define asthetic elements
colSplit <- hmDesign$celltype
labels <- row.names(hmCounts)
hmTitle <- "Overlap of genes up in CD11c+ Mac (Corbin), more accesible \nchromatin in iHPCs, upregulated transcripts in iHPCs"

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(celltype = hmDesign$celltype,
                        genotype = hmDesign$genotype,
                        # mouseID = hmDesign$mouseID, 
                        col = colors)
# Plot heatmap
hm <- Heatmap(tp, 
              show_column_names = FALSE, 
              show_row_names = TRUE, 
              row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
              cluster_columns = FALSE, 
              name = "row z-score", 
              top_annotation = ha, 
              col = col_fun, 
              cluster_rows = TRUE,
              column_title = hmTitle,
              column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
              show_row_dend = FALSE,
              column_split = colSplit,
              heatmap_legend_param = list(legend_direction = "horizontal"))

hm <- draw(hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
 
# pdf(file.path(dirPlots, folderName, "hm_overlapGenes_Corbin_iHPCaccChrom_iHPCtransc.pdf"),
#     height = 4, width = 5)

# invisible(dev.off())
```
